records.observation: A human-readable learning card can drift from the canonical improvement-loop registry unless its bytes are checked against the source registry.
records.operating_envelope: source-local improvement-loop registry and generated Markdown projection on a clean candidate
facts: The registry is the existing authority for improvement-loop state.
The projection is a reader-facing view and must not become a second authority.
interpretations: A digest-linked deterministic projection makes stale or hand-edited learning guidance observable without adding a knowledge store.
hypotheses: Recomputing projection bytes from the exact registry bytes will reject stale and hand-edited guidance before package claims are considered.
counterevidence: The projection check does not prove that an adopted learning improves installed runtime or human use.
records.mechanism_hypothesis: The existing improvement-loop audit can own a pure byte-and-digest comparison for the projection.
records.recurrence: Any future learning record that exposes a human-readable projection can otherwise drift silently.
records.intervention_burden: one deterministic read-only comparison during the existing package check
records.proposed_intervention: Generate the Markdown projection from registry bytes and reject any digest or byte mismatch.
rejected_alternatives: A peer knowledge store with independent status.
A hand-authored receipt or reviewer attestation as projection authority.

baseline: Current registry loop closes without a learning adoption or projection check.
visible: Adopted record renders the use condition, mechanism, evidence, owner, and rollback.
held_out: A second record with a different disposition renders without changing the adopted card.
negative_controls: A missing projection, stale registry digest, or altered line fails closed.
overlap: The registry remains the only learning authority; no second store or lifecycle is introduced.
already_specified: The existing improvement-loop receipt and WorkerResult-v1 remain unchanged.
no_change: No projection or authority change is made when registry bytes and projection bytes already match.
semantic_mutation: Renaming a record field or changing its status changes the expected projection and is detected.
specification_evolution: A future registry schema change must update the renderer and schema together before adoption.

results: The current candidate has one adopted learning and one held learning in the canonical registry.
The validator recomputes the projection and refuses stale or hand-edited bytes.
expiry_or_invalidation: The registry schema or projection path changes without a coordinated renderer update.
The projection ceases to be generated solely from registry bytes.
records.rollback: Remove the learning-adoption block and projection together, then retain the pre-existing loop receipt and validator behavior.
residual_risks: This source-local control does not establish product improvement, installation, runtime activation, or human adoption.
records.authority_handoff: The existing improvement-loop audit remains the sole executable checker; root retains adoption, claim, release, and completion authority.

repair_budget.operating_envelope: source-local improvement-loop registry and generated Markdown projection on a clean candidate
repair_budget.calibration_basis: One renderer correction and one exact confirmation are sufficient for a deterministic projection mismatch.

records.observation: A single repair-attempt count is tempting to reuse across all behavior and operating envelopes.
records.operating_envelope: behavior-level skill/control evaluation for source-local repair loops
facts: Repair cost and safe stopping conditions differ between deterministic projection work and behavior evaluation.
The semantic repair circuit breaker already records changed mechanism and evidence.
interpretations: A universal count would hide the named task family and operating envelope that justify the budget.
hypotheses: Keeping this learning held preserves calibrated budgets without adding a second repair tracker.
counterevidence: Some small deterministic repairs may share a practical budget, but that does not make the budget universal.
records.mechanism_hypothesis: The existing semantic repair circuit breaker should remain the mechanism, with each candidate record naming its own budget.
records.recurrence: The pressure to standardize repair counts recurs whenever a new evaluation family is added.
records.intervention_burden: none while held; calibrate only when a named task family supplies evidence
records.proposed_intervention: Adopt one universal three-attempt repair cap for every learning and skill evaluation.
rejected_alternatives: A hidden global counter outside the existing circuit breaker.
An unbounded retry loop justified by reviewer agreement.

baseline: Existing repair controls are task-specific and do not claim a universal cap.
visible: The held record names the proposed cap and the reason it is not adopted.
held_out: A different task family requires a separately calibrated budget.
negative_controls: A record declaring universal_count true is invalid.
overlap: No second repair tracker or lifecycle is introduced.
already_specified: The semantic repair circuit breaker remains current authority.
no_change: No universal cap is added while evidence is unresolved.
semantic_mutation: Changing the task family or envelope requires recalibration, not silent reuse.
specification_evolution: A future repair contract must preserve named calibration and the existing circuit breaker.

results: The proposed universal cap is held and no new global counter is introduced.
The adopted projection control uses a two-attempt budget only for its named deterministic task family.
expiry_or_invalidation: A representative behavior-evaluation corpus demonstrates a calibrated budget for a named task family.
The semantic repair circuit breaker changes authority.
records.rollback: Delete this held proposal from the registry if the root retires the universal-budget question without adopting it.
residual_risks: Future task families still require explicit budget calibration before repair work begins.
records.authority_handoff: The existing semantic repair circuit breaker and WorkerResult-v1 remain authoritative; this held record cannot authorize a repair or claim.

repair_budget.operating_envelope: behavior-level skill/control evaluation for source-local repair loops
repair_budget.calibration_basis: Provisional comparison only; not eligible for universal reuse while this learning is held.
